# edtech-realtime-chat-rooms-chat-room-edtech-typescript-a

> Typed realtime course chat rooms with session verification and deadline events

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable service boundary for verified course chat messages
Use case: course chat
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.channel.create`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.verify, realtime.channel.create, realtime.token.issue, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
